description: SCONE, published by CambridgeNuclear, implements object-oriented Monte Carlo neutron transport for reactor-physics research and graduate learning. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The authors position SCONE as a research and graduate-learning environment before contribution to established design codes. GNU/Linux, Fortran, BLAS and LAPACK are documented dependencies. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
